## Exercise

### Multiple choice Questions

1. What is the percentage of ethane in natural gas?
   a. 3%
   b. 4%
   c. 6%
   d. 7%

2. Which of the following compounds can cause the disappearance of red colour of bromine?
   a. $C_3H_8$
   b. $C_3H_8O$
   c. $C_3H_6O$
   d. $C_2H_4$

Reaction: $\text{CH}_3-\text{C}\equiv\text{CH} \xrightarrow{\text{Br}_2} \text{X} \xrightarrow{\text{Br}_2} \text{Y}$

Answer the questions 3 and 4 from the above reaction:

3. What is the name of compound Y?
   a. 1,1-dibromopropane
   b. 2,2-dibromopropane
   c. 1,1,2,2-tetrabromopropane
   d. 1,2-dibromopropene

4. In the stem X compound -
   i) gives an addition reaction
   ii) is used to produce plastic
   iii) is less reactive than Y

Which one of the followings is correct?
   a. i and ii
   b. ii and iii
   c. i and iii
   d. i, ii and iii
